Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in genealogical reasoning by misidentifying the ordinal generation. The WebSurfer correctly identified that Arthur Gore, 1st Earl of Arran, was the son of Sir Arthur Gore, 1st Baronet. However, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the 1st Baronet was the *paternal grandfather* of the 2nd Earl. In reality, the 1st Baronet is the *paternal great-grandfather* (the father of the 1st Earl, who is the father of the 2nd Earl). The Planner failed to correctly map the lineage: 2nd Earl -> 1st Earl -> 1st Baronet, instead treating the 1st Earl and 1st Baronet as the same generation or skipping a generation in the logic.
